THE EXPANDED LIBRARY EXPOSED A WIDOW THE BALANCING PASS COULD NOT REACH, and it is a defect in the paginator rather than in the writing. paginateBook()'s same-count pass re-runs paginate() with a smaller line budget and STOPS at the first cap whose page count changes — and for a long book that is the very first iteration, because a 16-page book gains a 17th the moment one line comes off every page. So the pass does nothing at all on long books. Measured over the 113 texts in a real browser: the-duelling-pick-and-the-bog-rapier ended on a page of ONE WORD, standing-instruction-for-auxiliaries on 18 and the-articles-of-the-wet-ledger on 21. A one-word page is exactly what RI-UIX05 §A B8 forbids. Fixed with two guarded fallbacks that only run after the existing pass has failed: (a) allow exactly one extra page and take the largest tail; (b) if even that has no candidate, split the final SPREAD evenly between its two pages, which keeps the page count. Result measured in the browser: 757 -> 769 pages, minimum page 1 word -> 10 words (and the 10 is a pre-existing 74-word scrap, not a widow), K1 still in band at p10 85.8 / median 121 / p90 154. The change cannot touch a book whose tail already clears the floor.

THE CONTRACTION DEFECT IS DISTRIBUTION, NOT RATE, AND THE ARITHMETIC SAYS SO. Across all seven martial files: 328 contractions in 49,818 words = 65.8 per 10k against Morrowind's measured book rate of 60.76. We are AT the reference in aggregate. But three texts hold 89% of them (the-serjeants-answer 648/10k, a-bill-mans-answer 721/10k, the-fen-zweihander 570/10k — all above Morrowind's DIALOGUE rate of 292) and twenty-seven texts have zero. So every writer in the library is either a Legate or a sweep victim, and there is no middle. The fix is not to flatten the three: it is to calibrate them to the reference speech rate (~290) and to let the bowyer, the rice-cutter, the lock-man and the memoirist write like the working people they are. Same finding shape as S6 register variance in r3 — the pace was mine, and so was the switch.

THE HEAVIEST TEXTS WERE OVER-CONTRACTED AGAINST THE REFERENCE, NOT JUST AGAINST THE BAND. the-serjeants-answer ran 648 contractions per 10k, a-bill-mans-answer 721, the-fen-zweihander 570 — against Morrowind's measured DIALOGUE rate of 292 and book rate of 60.8. Recalibrated to ~250-290 per 10k by expanding the argumentative stretches and keeping the contractions at the emotional peaks, which is what a man who can write actually does when he is angry in a margin.

I INTRODUCED FOUR NEW TIC INSTANCES WHILE FIXING TICS AND THE GATE CAUGHT ALL FOUR IN THE SAME SESSION. De-contracting `That's the whole reason` produced `That is the whole reason` (a live TIC_THAT_IS hit); recasting an indefinite person produced `Nobody had.` and `somebody has to stand in front of the young`; and rewriting a bowyer's quoted line produced a sentence-initial `Which` fragment. This is the decay W1-PROSE-TICS documented, observed inside a single pass by the author of the pass. The tool comment warning that a contraction sweep can HIDE a tic from the checker is exactly right, and it can also CREATE one.
